sources.market: Tushare daily_info: SH_MARKET (SH_A + SH_B before 2019) + SZ_MARKET
sources.turnover: Tushare daily_info: float_mv-weighted tr of SH_A, SH_B, SH_STAR (since 2019-07-22), SZ_MARKET
sources.volume: SH: daily_info.vol in 100 million shares, SH_MARKET or SH_A+SH_B before 2019; SZ: sz_daily_info 股票.vol in shares / 1e8; if missing use daily_info SZ_MARKET.vol, then disjoint SZ_MAIN+SZ_SME (before 2021-04-06)+SZ_GEM (from 2009-10-30), all in 100 million shares

methodology.scope: Shanghai/Shenzhen stocks including A/B shares; excludes Beijing, funds and bonds
methodology.sampling: amount/volume/turnover: arithmetic mean of valid trading-day observations per ISO week; other metrics: last valid observation per ISO week; x-axis uses each metric's last observation date
methodology.turnover: First calculate daily float_mv-weighted turnover from disjoint boards, then average the daily rates within each week
methodology.missing: No zero fill or carry-forward; financing starts with the 2010 launch; limit list starts in 2020
methodology.weeklyMean: ISO Monday-Sunday weeks; holidays/weekends and missing values excluded, valid zeros included; partial weeks average only observations available by the data cutoff; per-point dates/day counts stored in weeklySamples
